note: The homepage is in English (html lang=en) and has no language switcher. The Cards menu, the Credit Cards product tile, and the Learn More button all point at https://rcbccredit.com/, which is not in official_domains. The Apply Now button on the same tile points at https://applications.rcbccredit.com/, also not in official_domains. A recipe run must not fetch those hosts. No individual credit card product pages were found on rcbc.com. robots.txt on www.rcbc.com allows all paths other than /cgi-bin/, /tmp/, /admin/, and /search*. sitemap.xml is present and was used as a second list; it has articles about credit cards but no on-host card catalogue. MyDebit at /mydebit is a debit product and was not handed in as a credit card.
